def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, (v, wt) in cache.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will re-add to mark as most recently used)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            else:
                # Key is new - check if we need to evict
                if len(cache) >= capacity:
                    # Evict least recently used (first item in OrderedDict)
                    cache.popitem(last=False)
            
            # Add the new entry
            cache[key] = (value, t)
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, (v, wt) in cache.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # Check if key exists
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                # Mark as most recently used by moving to end
                del cache[key]
                cache[key] = (value, write_time)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
